utterances.text: Hello, my dear! How have you been lately?
Hi Grandma! I've been doing well, just busy with school and some projects. How about you?
Is there anything exciting happening in your life these days? I'd love to hear all about it!
Well, I've been working on a really cool science project about renewable energy. It's been a lot of fun and I'm learning so much! What about you, Grandma? Any new hobbies or projects?
It sounds like you might be a bit busy or distracted. If there's anything you'd like to share or talk about, I'm here to listen whenever you're ready.
Thanks, Grandma! I appreciate that. I'm really excited about this project, and it's been keeping me on my toes. How about you? Have you picked up any new hobbies or projects lately?
Alright, dear. If you need a moment, that's perfectly fine. I'm here whenever you want to chat more. Just let me know!
Thanks, Grandma! I really appreciate your patience. I'm actually not too busy to chat right now. I was just curious about what you've been up to lately. Anything new or interesting?
I see, dear. It sounds like you might be using some new expressions I'm not familiar with. If you want to share more about what you mean, I'm all ears!
Oh, sorry if I used any confusing expressions, Grandma! I just meant to ask if you've been up to anything new or fun recently. I'd love to hear about it!
I hope that clears things up! So, have you been working on any new projects or hobbies? I'd love to hear all about them.
